characters.name: Ren
characters.appearance: Black hair, indigo cloak, amber eyes

scenes.logline: Ren watches a fractured moon from a rainy rooftop, holding a sealed letter.
A red streak cuts across the sky. Ren runs toward the rooftop edge as the city lights blink.
Ren opens the letter. A warm light rises into the storm, and the moon begins to heal.
scenes.dialogue: Even the longest night must end.
